visual_findings.DR3012GC24-003: English IBIS-IP version character list on page 18 visibly contains the duplicated digit sequence 0,1,2,2,3,... while describing the allowed version characters.
visual_findings.DR3012GC24-004: German and English example/glossary contexts visibly contain typo-like technical service identifiers including DeviceManagmenService, CustomumerInformationService, DeviceManagmentServices and PassengerCountigService.
visual_findings.DR3012GC24-005: Page 18 visibly states that each service is versioned independently and there is no common IBIS-IP version; page 22 nevertheless uses stale umbrella wording referring to Version 1.0 of IBIS-IP.

active_disproof_and_context.DR3012GC24-001: Selected DeviceClassEnumeration contains OnBoardUnit and not OnBordUnit; executable samples confirm OnBoardUnit valid and OnBordUnit invalid.
